name: Merida Flowerpiercer
rangeDescription: Andes of western venezuela (trujillo, mérida, and northern táchira)
description: Small tanager-like bird with sharply hooked, slightly upturned bill. Black body and chestnut belly set off by blue-gray eyebrow and shoulder patch.

name: Long-billed Woodcreeper
rangeDescription: Eastern colombia to southwestern venezuela, northern bolivia, amazonian brazil, and french guiana
description: This large and unmistakable woodcreeper is widespread across much of Amazonia. It has a long pinkish bill, white throat, and distinct white streaking on the neck and breast.

name: Gray-crowned Prinia
rangeDescription: Himalayan foothills of northern india (kashmir to bhutan and southern assam)
description: Small, rather stumpy-looking prinia with a highly restricted range in the south-central and southeastern Himalayan foothills. Warm brown with pale underparts and a gray crown.

name: Hazel-fronted Pygmy-Tyrant
rangeDescription: East slope of andes of southern peru (puno) and western bolivia
description: Small brown flycatcher found in humid forest from southern Peru to central Bolivia. Very plain; adults have a faint rusty tinge on the head, but this is lacking in young birds.

name: Vermiculated Fishing-Owl
rangeDescription: Southern cameroon to central african republic, democratic republic of the congo, gabon, and northern angola
description: A round-headed, gingery fishing-owl with heavily streaked underparts and a yellow beak. It is shy and day-roosts are well hidden in huge trees along rivers in lowland primary, swamp and flooded forests.

name: Rapa Shearwater
rangeDescription: Rapa island (austral islands)
description: A small black-and-white shearwater with a relatively long rounded tail and an extensively white face. Similar to Bannerman’s and Newell’s Shearwaters, but smaller, with white on the face extending above the eye.

name: Scarlet-headed Blackbird
rangeDescription: Marshes of northern bolivia (beni and santa cruz), paraguay, southern brazil, and northern argentina
description: A stunning blackbird with a sharply-pointed bill. The mostly black body contrasts with a bright orange-red head, breast, and thighs.

name: Araripe Manakin
rangeDescription: Eastern brazil (chapada do araripe in ceará)
description: Strikingly beautiful white manakin with a red crown and black tail and flight feathers. Females are olive-green, paler below; note the short crest above the bill.

name: Sao Tome Prinia
rangeDescription: São tomé island (gulf of guinea)
description: An active, slender, unstreaked warbler with a long graduated tail that is sometimes cocked. Gray above and pale below.
imageCreditName: Lars Petersson | My World of Bird Photography

name: Timor Oriole
rangeDescription: Rote, timor, and semau (eastern lesser sundas)
description: Male is a distinctive oriole with a green head, dark mask, and orange-red bill. Duller female is brown above and paler below, with a dark mask and black bill.

name: Patagonian Mockingbird
rangeDescription: Central and southern argentina and southern chile
description: Fairly common in Argentine Patagonia, but local and scarce in southern Chile. Favors semiopen habitats, from shrub-steppe to farmland with hedges and shrubby patches.

name: Black-winged Pratincole
rangeDescription: Romania to southwestern russia and northern kazakhstan; winters to south africa
description: Similar to other pratincoles, the Black-winged Pratincole is an elegant shorebird of dry habitats, not necessarily mud. Very similar to Collared Pratincole, but in flight lacks whitish wing trailing edge seen on Collared and the underwing feathers are black not rufous.

name: Cocos Tyrannulet
rangeDescription: Cocos island (off western costa rica)
description: Small and drab flycatcher found only on Cocos Island, which is located in the Pacific Ocean about 300 miles southwest of mainland Costa Rica. Most birds are brown above with a buffy belly, with tan wingbars and a pale eyebrow.

name: Amazonian Parrotlet
rangeDescription: Tropical southeastern peru and northwestern bolivia (probably adjacent western brazil)
description: Rare, short-tailed parakeet. Small and green, with a light bluish wash on the face.

name: Bare-eyed White-eye
rangeDescription: Open woodland of rennell (southeastern solomon islands)
description: A distinctive round-bodied, short-tailed white-eye with a beady black eye and a broad white outer eye-ring. Has a long pinkish or yellow bill with a variable dark tip.
imageCreditName: Lars Petersson | My World of Bird Photography

name: Crimson-breasted Finch
rangeDescription: Arid scrub of western ecuador and far northwestern peru
description: Small finch-like bird restricted to the lowlands of western Ecuador, northwestern Peru, and extreme southwestern Colombia. Male is glossy-black with fiery red underparts and crown.

name: Bower's Shrikethrush
rangeDescription: Montane rainforest of northeastern queensland (cooktown to ingham)
description: Sturdy songbird with substantial bill. Male brown above, peach-buff below, with black bill, grayish head, and pale throat and breast with faint streaking.

name: Cherry-throated Tanager
rangeDescription: Southeastern brazil (rediscovered after 47-year absence in espírito santo)
description: Striking, fairly small tanager with a black-and-gray back and white underparts contrasting with a bright red throat. Note the yellow eyes.

name: Moluccan Goshawk
rangeDescription: Northern moluccas (bacan, halmahera, ternate, and morotai)
description: A fairly large, dark gray goshawk with deep rufous underparts, including barred thighs on adults. Yellow eyes, bill base, and legs.

name: Slender-billed Kite
rangeDescription: Eastern panama to the guianas, northern bolivia, and amazonian brazil
description: Medium-sized, dark raptor with distinctive shape. Adult plumage is entirely slate gray with red legs; immature similar but shows some pale barring on underparts and tail.
